activate_mansion_switch.description: Interacts with Mewtwo Statue 2 at (2, 11) from (2, 12) facing UP to successfully toggle the gate state to State B. It prints a sequence of 'A' presses and sleeps to bypass auto-advance.
activate_mansion_switch.python_script:
import json

# Correct button sequence:
# 1. A (interact)
# 2. A (advance to YES/NO)
# 3. Up (move cursor to YES)
# 4. A (select YES)
# 5. A (close confirmation text)
sequence = [
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "Up",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A"
]

print(json.dumps(sequence))

history.commit_message: Define activate_mansion_switch tool to toggle Mewtwo Statue 2 switch under State B without triggering harness auto-advance.
Update activate_mansion_switch to press Up before selecting YES to correctly toggle Statue 2 to State B.
